# yt-dlp/ejs

`lib.min.js` and `core.min.js` of yt-dlp-ejs 0.8.0 (https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs), the solver yt-dlp uses for YouTube's signature and n challenges. Unlicense (LICENSE). `lib.min.js` bundles meriyah (ISC) and astring (MIT); their license texts are in its header.

To update, copy the two files of a newer release over these. Without a rebuild, the two files can also be put into `~/.local/share/quince/ejs/`, where they win over the built-in ones.
